function.name: baza_sorov
function.description:
Run a READ-ONLY SQL query (SELECT or WITH only) against a business database and return rows.
Live databases are PostgreSQL (use PostgreSQL syntax: now(), date_trunc, interval '7 days', ILIKE);
SQLite copies use SQLite syntax. Use aggregation (COUNT, SUM, GROUP BY) instead of fetching many rows.
Max 200 rows are returned. In PostgreSQL list columns explicitly (SELECT * is not permitted).

function.name: bazalar_tuzilishi
function.description:
Show available business databases, or the structure of one database: tables, columns with types, row counts
and 2 sample rows per table. ALWAYS call this before writing SQL for a database you have not inspected yet.
Prefer the live PostgreSQL database for current data; SQLite copies are older snapshots.

baza.description: Database name (e.g. "kamera_jonli"). Empty = list all databases.

function.name: brauzer
function.description:
Control a real Chromium browser (renders JavaScript). Use it when sahifani_ochish returns empty/incomplete text
(dynamic sites: e-commerce, banks, railway/airline tickets, maps), or when you must interact with a page:
fill a search box, press buttons, open menus, scroll. The browser keeps state between calls in this chat.
Every call returns the page URL, title, visible text, links and a screenshot link.

amal.description:
Action: "ochish" (open url), "bosish" (click element by its visible text `matn`, or by x,y),
"yozish" (type `matn` into field whose placeholder/label is `joy`; empty joy = focused field),
"tugma" (press key `tugma`, e.g. Enter, Tab, Escape), "aylantirish" (scroll, yonalish=pastga|yuqoriga),
"korish" (look at current page again), "yopish" (close browser session).

matn.description: Text to click (bosish) or to type (yozish).

joy.description: Placeholder or label of the input field for "yozish".

x.description: X coordinate for clicking (optional, with y).

y.description: Y coordinate for clicking (optional, with x).

function.name: chatdagi_fayllar
function.description:
List files the user attached to this chat (Excel, Word, PDF, CSV, images) with their paths inside the
execute_code environment. Call this first whenever you need to process an attached file with Python code,
then open it in execute_code by the returned path (e.g. pd.read_excel(path)).

function.name: chuqur_tadqiqot
function.description:
Deep research: runs several web searches in parallel, automatically OPENS the best result pages and returns
their extracted text. Use for questions that need multiple sources: comparisons, reports, prices, laws, market
analysis, "chuqur o'rgan", "tadqiqot qil". Base the answer ONLY on the returned page texts and cite their URLs.

sorovlar.description: 3-6 different search queries covering sub-questions (mix Uzbek, Russian and English).

sahifalar_soni.description: How many pages to open in total (4-12).

function.name: github_korish

path.description: Optional file or folder path inside the repo, e.g. src/main.py

function.name: internetdan_qidirish
function.description:
Search the internet for fresh information: news, prices, exchange rates, events, products, people.
ALWAYS use this for anything recent or uncertain instead of answering from memory.
Read the snippets; open the 1-2 most relevant results with sahifani_ochish when you need exact numbers.

query.description: Search query. Use English or Russian keywords for international topics, Uzbek for local ones.

sahifalar.description: Optional: open this many top pages automatically (0-3). Default 0.

function.name: sahifani_ochish
function.description:
Open a web page and return its readable text. Use it to read a link the user gave, or a search result,
before describing its content. Never describe a page you have not opened with this tool.
For GitHub repositories prefer github_korish.

url.description: Full URL starting with http:// or https://

function.name: valyuta_kursi
function.description:
Official exchange rates of the Central Bank of Uzbekistan (cbu.uz) to UZS. Use this for any exchange rate question
instead of web search.

valyuta.description: Currency code like USD, EUR, RUB, CNY, KZT, GBP, or "all" for every currency.

sana.description: Optional date YYYY-MM-DD for historical rate; empty means the latest official rate.

function.name: rasmlardan_excel
function.description:
Convert tables in the screenshots/images attached to this chat into ONE Excel file. Reads every image
separately at high resolution, merges rows in image order, removes duplicate rows from overlapping
screenshots. Use this whenever the user sends screenshots of a table and asks for Excel/CSV/a table —
do NOT transcribe rows yourself.

fayl_nomi.description: Output file name without extension, Latin letters/digits/underscore only (e.g. "kameralar").
